Lesson vocabulary

Six words you will need today

Artifact
a finished thing next to the chat: doc, slides, dashboard
Project
a folder: files + rules for one topic
Memory
what Claude remembers about you across chats
Connector
access to your service: Drive, Gmail, GitHub
Skill
a ready recipe: “how to build a report”
Agent
takes many steps towards a goal by itself
You saw similar things in L07: Copilot also has agents, connectors and memory. Different names — same ideas.

Models

One menu — four models

Screenshot: claude.ai, 13 Oct 2026, the course author’s account (chat history blurred)
Fable 5.1
the hardest tasks; slower and pricier
«For your toughest challenges»
Opus 5.5
a good default
«For complex work and everyday tasks»
Sonnet 5.5
simpler tasks, saves your limit
«Most efficient for simpler tasks»
Haiku 5.5
quick short answers
«Fastest for quick answers»
Rule: smarter → slower and uses your limit faster. Effort — how long the model “thinks” before answering.

Definition

An artifact is something you would put in front of another person

Claude makes an artifact when the result is…
  • Substantial — usually more than 15 lines
  • Self-contained — makes sense without the chat
  • Worth editing and improving
  • Useful later — you will come back or show it
A short answer (“how many urgent?”) is just an answer, not an artifact.

Live demo

Table → dashboard → stand-up slides

1A file + one sentence
2Dashboard
3“Make 3 slides for stand-up”
Before showing it — check
Urgent on top? T-110 first — a customer sees other people’s orders
Customer emails on screen? No
Do the numbers match the file? 11 open, 4 urgent — checked
The first version is a draft. If you don’t like it, be precise: “move urgent tickets without an owner to the top”, not “make it better”.

Safety

A public link is a publication

Share
1
1 “Anyone with the link” — anyone who has it can see
Settings → Privacy
2
2 “Help improve our AI models” — your chats are used for training. Your call.
Never paste into the chat
  • passwords, keys, card numbers
  • personal data of customers and colleagues
  • confidential company documents — without permission
A new artifact is visible only to you. Share it once you’ve checked there’s no personal data inside.
Screenshot: claude.ai, 13 Oct 2026, the course author’s account (chat history blurred)
GenAI Basics • Lesson 09 • Claude Ecosystem and Artifacts20 / 21
Homework • summary

Make two things of different types

1. A deck or a document
on a work or study topic
2. A dashboard, diagram or coach
from your own anonymised data
Hand in: 2 prompts, 2 links or screenshots and one fix you asked for after checking.
Four rules
1
Chat to think, artifact to make a thing
2
Ask precisely: what, for whom, from which data
3
Check: numbers, made-up facts, personal data
4
Share deliberately: a link = a publication
Lesson 10: open models on your own computer (LM Studio) and in the cloud.
